input.command:
COMPANY_ID="9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5"
cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip/packages/deploy-cloudflare
timeout 50 npx wrangler dev --no-bundle --local 2>&1 &
WRANGLER_PID=$!
sleep 8

pass() { echo "PASS: $1"; }
fail() { echo "FAIL: $1 — $2"; }

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null http://localhost:8787/api/health)
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/health" || fail "GET /api/health" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null http://localhost:8787/api/companies)
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies" || fail "GET /api/companies" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID")
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies/:id" || fail "GET /api/companies/:id" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID/agents")
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies/:id/agents" || fail "GET /api/companies/:id/agents" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID/issues")
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies/:id/issues" || fail "GET /api/companies/:id/issues" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID/projects")
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies/:id/projects" || fail "GET /api/companies/:id/projects" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/$COMPANY_ID/dashboard")
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies/:id/dashboard" || fail "GET /api/companies/:id/dashboard" "$result"

result=$(curl -sw "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/stats")
[ "$result" = "200" ] && pass "GET /api/companies/stats" || fail "GET /api/companies/stats" "$result"

kill $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
input.description: Final smoke test of all major API routes
